'''Anomaly 2249''' was an anomaly in space. It was a metal mesh cylinder about 60 [[meter]]s long. The tops were 15 meters across and had circular metal fittings. The ''[[Lady Luck]]'' visited this anomaly to search for the ''[[Teljkon Vagabond]]''.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
